finding.description: In exp_quotient and simple_quotient, the correct answer is always the only row without a fraction outside dy/dx. Learners can hide the ODE and select that row. The invariant survives shuffling and delivery filtering. Actual batch question 7412ba17-9fc5-51fc-b2a5-80c01769de08 is affected.

finding.requested_change: Change normal-generation bank construction in both quotient families so fractionless layout cannot uniquely identify the correct answer. Include plausible same-scope incorrect fractionless equations and vary distractor roles. Preserve observed banks for source replay, retain both families, and keep the strict shortcut regression. Replace the affected batch member after validating the revised bank; numerical changes or shuffling alone do not repair this rule.

finding.description: Both revised quotient profiles repeat the correct dependent power four times and its RHS three times, enabling prompt-blind modal-component selection. In quotient-power-sign, the correct answer is also always the shortest of three rows sharing one left side. Both cues affect batch question 4cc34a53-2d0e-5e5d-9f42-8f3c31da05f8.
finding.reproduction: From evidence_root run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python minimal_repro.py; it exits 1. Minimal case: generate_easy(seed=17, template="simple_quotient", parameters={"n":1}). Writing D=dy/dx, its choices are yD=1/x, yD=x, xD=y, yD=-x and y^2D=x. Hide the ODE and choose the shortest of the three yD rows: yD=x. The exact batch witness uses seed=2404317989, exp_quotient, base=4, a=4, n=4.
finding.requested_change: Change quotient_bank’s family-wide distractor construction so modal component frequencies and the shortest RHS within a repeated-LHS subgroup cannot determine correctness. Retain both families, observed source replay and mathematical correctness. Preserve the old regression, adopt these new failing probes, and regenerate the affected batch member after repairing the rule.

reason.summary: Two quotient templates expose a prompt-blind answer-choice shortcut. It succeeds on 13/13 fresh tests and affects one of five actual batch records after delivery filtering. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Identify h(x)g(y), then select the equivalent separated equation (1/g(y))dy/dx=h(x).
reasoning_steps: Identify the independent x and y factors.
Take the reciprocal of the y factor.
Distinguish a separated equation from an equivalent but unseparated rearrangement.
invariants: Stop at separation; do not integrate.
Preserve the five-choice radio response contract.
Respect domains and require one correct separated equation.
permitted_variations: Vary supported coefficients, powers, exponential factors and rational shifts.
Vary direct versus reciprocal dependent factors within the supported scope.
Vary distractor roles and correct-choice position without making layout predict correctness.
